doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Mr. Jones date with Elvin Jones
summary: Liebman recalls the many percussionists on the July 1972 Mr. Jones sessions and is unsure which tunes were recorded that day.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: On the Corner we’ve talked about. There’s a couple more dates, the Mr. Jones date with Elvin.
That’s put together from, I think, a few dates.
That’s July 12th and 13th, ’72, at Van Gelder’s.

I seem to remember that some of the tunes were from maybe another date. I don’t remember. Mr. Jones is not a – I don’t think we sat and did it. That’s a lot of percussionists there. Frank Ippolito was there.
Yeah. Albert Duffy on timpani, and Patato.
There was a whole bunch of cats. I don’t remember much about that. I think New Breed’s on that, studio version.
But I’m not sure we did it that day. For some reason I think some of that record was recorded at another time. Maybe I’m wrong. Maybe they’re more right than I am.
